CustomField.label: Plan Signature
CustomField.description: Routing runs only. One line per placement this run decided: appointment id, engineer id, start time in whole minutes since the epoch - Salesforce stores SchedStartTime to the minute, so comparing seconds never matches. This is how the next run tells a manual assignment from an automatic one - a scheduled appointment that is not in here was put there by a person, so it gets pinned instead of moved. Pinned visits are deliberately absent, because they were a person's decision and not this run's.
